summary: pipeline CLI diagnostics land on STDOUT, so a CLI whose stdout is a data channel cannot be redirected cleanly
evidence: node src/cli/enrichment-prompt.ts <id> > case.txt put {"level":"info",...,"msg":"posthog ai telemetry registered"} as line 1 of case.txt, ahead of the compiled prompt. buildApp() configures Fastify's pino with no stream override, so it inherits pino's stdout default.
